items.source: Adds given paths to remove mutations. See Remove for more details.
items.translation: 添加给定路径以移除突变。 有关更多详细信息，请参阅Remove。

items.source: Adds given paths to insert mutations. See Insert for more details.
items.translation: 添加给定路径以插入突变。 有关更多详细信息，请参阅Insert。

items.source: Adds given paths to upsert mutations. See Upsert for more details.
items.translation: 将给定的路径添加到上写突变中。有关更多详细信息，请参阅Upsert。

items.source: Adds given paths to replace mutations. See Replace for more details.

items.source: Marks that the CAS value should be provided with the mutations to protect against concurrent modifications.
items.translation: 标记 CAS 值应随突变一起提供，以防止并发修改。

items.source:
Marks that the CAS value should be provided with the mutations to protect against concurrent modifications.
By default the CAS value is not provided.
items.translation: 标记 CAS 值应随突变一起提供，以防止并发修改。默认情况下不提供 CAS 值。
